The '''RGC-6b escape pod'''<ref name="Epic Battles">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles]]''</ref> was a model of [[escape pod]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="Zero Hour" /> as well as the [[gangster]] [[Azmorigan]].<ref name="Idiot's Array" /> They were crewed by one [[pilot]] and could accommodate a number of passengers.<ref name="Siege Concept" /> ''[[Phoenix Home]]'',<ref name="Siege" /> ''[[Merchant One]]'',<ref name="Idiot's Array" /> and ''[[Vanguard]]'' were equipped with RGC-6b escape pods.<ref name="Zero Hour" />
